revisions.finalTarget: हर लेखक की ID अद्वितीय होनी चाहिए।
revisions.rationale: The caller validates multiple author IDs. The proposal mixes English pluralization into Hindi; this says that each author's ID must be unique.

revisions.finalTarget: Aucun jeton d’API Hardcover n’est configuré (ajoutez-en un à cette liste d’importation ou dans les paramètres).
revisions.rationale: Use the idiomatic French construction “jeton d’API Hardcover” and translate the action as adding a token to this import list or Settings.

revisions.finalTarget: Chưa cấu hình token API của Hardcover (hãy thêm token vào danh sách nhập này hoặc phần Cài đặt).
revisions.rationale: Clarify that it is the Hardcover API token, not a generic token, and keep the two configuration locations explicit.

revisions.finalTarget: 프록시를 통해 {value0}에 성공적으로 연결했습니다. 응답 시간: {value1}ms.
revisions.rationale: The primary wording can read as a proxy connection followed by a value. This explicitly says the connection to {value0} succeeded through the proxy.

revisions.finalTarget: لم تعد معاملات البرامج النصية المخصصة مدعومة.
revisions.rationale: The primary “الوسائط” can mean media. In this scripting-settings caller, the source means script arguments; use “معاملات”.

revisions.finalTarget: {value0} से कम होने पर H&R होता है।
revisions.rationale: The source states that falling below the threshold leads to H&R. “हो सकता है” weakens that to possibility; use a direct consequence.

revisions.finalTarget: لم يتم إعداد ملف تعريف البيانات الوصفية للكتب الصوتية لهذا المؤلف (الكتب الصوتية معطّلة). اضبط ملف تعريف البيانات الوصفية للكتب الصوتية لإضافة كتب صوتية.
revisions.rationale: The primary wording can be read as setting up a metadata file, while the caller means configuring a metadata profile. State the profile explicitly in both sentences.

revisions.finalTarget: Für diesen Autor ist kein Hörbuch-Metadatenprofil eingerichtet (Hörbücher sind deaktiviert). Richten Sie ein Hörbuch-Metadatenprofil ein, um Hörbücher hinzuzufügen.
revisions.rationale: The primary leaves “Audiobook(s)” in English throughout. “Hörbuch” is the natural German term here, including in the metadata-profile setting.

revisions.finalTarget: 암호 문구는 {value0}자 이상이어야 하며 UTF-8 기준 최대 {value1}바이트까지 허용됩니다.
revisions.rationale: The primary repeats the minimum requirement with “최소 ... 이상.” This uses one minimum construction and states the maximum UTF-8 byte limit separately.
